name: zeffect_anim_discard_last_activation_record
description: zEffect_Anim::DiscardLastActivationRecord drops the most recently allocated activation record by decrementing the global activation-record count.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through activation-record queue count checks.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x461a90 is a direct decrement of g_zEffectAnim_ActivationRecordCount followed by return.
The native zEffect activation-record smoke verifies that discarding after allocation reduces the global activation-record count to zero.
